topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: The room spins, or perhaps it's just me. I find myself wondering how the sunlight could be so warm, so comforting, when everything feels so cold. I've been trying to understand, to piece together the puzzle of it all. It's strange, really, how words that once sounded like a song now echo like a storm. I remember the laughter, the easy smiles, and now, I catch myself looking for the clouds behind them. Everything seems a bit off, like the world is a step away, just out of reach. Yet, there's a part of me that yearns to believe, to trust, even when the ground feels unsteady.
